_comment: The persistent host's settings (agent-runner skill). Every field has a default; the file may be
absent. port/bind: where the page listens — 127.0.0.1 only until the LAN follow-up (bind 0.0.0.0
plus a token). fanoutRoot: null = derived from the exe's location (the repo's fanout/).
maxParallel / utilizationCap: the HOST's ceilings across every batch; a job file's values are
the run's own ceilings, effective = min. Both are adjustable live on the page; changes go to
fanout/host-log.txt and are not written back here — a different default is an edit to this file.
mapPath: the process map the /protocol route renders, absolute or relative to the repo root;
null = .claude/skills/v3-buildout/map.md, falling back to v3-buildout-2/map.md until the swap.
